note: Finite-state intake workflows. The model phrases turns and may request a transition with the advance_workflow tool; this file decides which transitions exist, which facts each step requires, and which curated procedure the step ends at. Nothing here is generated at runtime.

nodes.ask: How much is still unpaid, and for which months?
Who do you work for — a company or contractor, or a household?
Do you work for more than one household, or through an agency?
nodes.note: Domestic workers are covered by different state rules than factory or office employees, so this changes which office to approach.

nodes.ask: Do you have anything in writing — an appointment letter, salary slips, or messages about the pay?

workflows.label: Police refused to register an FIR

nodes.ask: Did the police refuse in writing, or only verbally?
Do you have the written refusal, or a receipt or diary number for the complaint?
Which police station and district is this, and when did you go?
nodes.note: A written refusal is the strongest basis for escalating to the Superintendent of Police or the Magistrate.
